CAF.note: The AI tool is in health, which this study excludes.

facts.fact: MSF reports that, with the health authorities, it equipped Batangafo district hospital in 2024 with CAD4TB, an AI tool that scores chest X-rays and sends high-score patients to laboratory confirmation.
MSF reports that in 2025 CAD4TB helped detect 90 of the 203 TB cases screened in the Batangafo area.

CAF.note: CAD4TB is a foreign product; nothing built in the country.
